The combination of TEAM_A's home fouling tendency and TEAM_B's ability to draw disciplinary responses may produce elevated card counts. The question is whether TEAM_A commits more fouls and yellow cards against possession-dominant opponents at home.

Coverage risk is high given only 6 home matches in the sample.
